checks.name: phase_k_files_exist
command: test -f Source/StateManager.h && test -f Source/StateManager.cpp && test -f Source/Profiles.h && test -f Source/Profiles.cpp && test -f Source/PluginProcessor.h && test -f Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && test -f Source/PluginEditor.cpp && test -f CMakeLists.txt && test -f Resources/Presets/PreAmp_TightSixString.json && test -f Resources/Presets/Rhythm_ModernCleanup.json && test -f Resources/Presets/Lead_SingingFocus.json && test -f Resources/Presets/Bass_ClangControl.json && test -f Resources/Presets/Diag_FindResonances.json && test -f tests/StateTests.cpp

checks.name: cmake_lists_phase_k_sources
command: rg -q "Profiles\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "StateManager\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "StateTests\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: ab_and_gain_match_apis
command: rg -q "copyAtoB|copyAToB|copy.*A.*B" Source/StateManager.h Source/StateManager.cpp && rg -q "A/B|ActiveSlot|abState|switchActive|slot" Source/StateManager.h Source/StateManager.cpp && rg -q "[Mm]atch|[Gg]ainMatch|G_match|getMatchGain" Source/StateManager.h Source/StateManager.cpp && rg -q "freeze|Freeze" Source/StateManager.h Source/StateManager.cpp

checks.name: profiles_placement_and_tuning
command: rg -q "Pre-Amp|PreAmp|Rhythm|Lead|Bass" Source/Profiles.h Source/Profiles.cpp && rg -q "E Standard|Drop D|tuning|Tuning" Source/Profiles.h Source/Profiles.cpp && rg -q "Placement|placement" Source/Profiles.h Source/Profiles.cpp

checks.name: delta_audition_and_processor_wiring
command: rg -q "DeltaAudition|RejectedSignal|deltaAudition|removed.signal|ListenRemoved" Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && rg -q "StateManager|Profiles|crossfade|Crossfade|gainMatch|GainMatch|profileIndex|tuningIndex" Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp Source/PluginEditor.cpp
